breakNotes.Winter Vacation: Winter Vacation runs Dec. 23–Jan. 6. Jan. 7 is listed as a teacher work and make-up day, followed by the weekend, so the draft has students returning Monday, Jan. 10. FWCS also notes that additional Winter Break days are included.
breakNotes.Spring Vacation: The draft lists Spring Vacation for Apr. 4–8. It does not publish a student return date after the break, and waiver days are not yet listed. Good Friday is listed separately for Apr. 14.

gradingPeriodsDescription: The draft lists quarter totals of 46, 43, 43, and 48 student days, for 89 days in the first semester and 91 in the second. customSections.content: The 2027–28 draft moves the districtwide first student day one day earlier, while Transition Day and the Pre-K start date remain TBD. It also lists a longer Winter Vacation, running Dec. 23 through Jan. 6.

calendarFaqs.q: When does Fort Wayne Community Schools start in 2027–28?
calendarFaqs.a: The current draft lists August 11, 2027, as the districtwide first student day. FWCS has not yet published Transition Day for kindergarten and grades 6 and 9 or the first day of Pre-K.

calendarFaqs.q: Which FWCS dates may be used as make-up days in 2027–28?
calendarFaqs.a: The draft labels January 7 and May 26 as teacher work and make-up days and May 30–31 as reserve make-up dates. It also labels May 30 as Memorial Day, although Memorial Day falls on May 29 in 2028. Check later FWCS revisions before treating any of these dates as student attendance days.

calendarFaqs.q: Is the October 29 FWCS conference date a school day?
calendarFaqs.a: No. FWCS designates Oct. 29, 2027, as a Release Day for parent-teacher conferences; students do not attend school that day.

calendarFaqs.q: Why is the FWCS 2027–28 Winter Vacation longer?
calendarFaqs.a: The draft lists Winter Vacation from December 23 through January 6 and explicitly notes that extra Winter Break days are listed. Because waiver days are not yet listed, the schedule may change in a later version.
